body_text:
A family of subsets of $U$ is itself a subset
$\mathcal{A}\subseteq\mathcal{P}(U)$. This distinction keeps
two membership levels separate: $x\in A$ concerns an element of
one subset, whereas $A\in\mathcal{A}$ concerns one set in the
family. Many indexing errors are failures to distinguish these
levels.
